questions.stem: Suspected thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura. Plasma exchange:

options.text: Starts now, without waiting for the enzyme result
Is replaced by a platelet transfusion for the number
Starts only after a week of steroids

questions.explanation: Do not wait for the enzyme that cuts von Willebrand factor. Start exchange now.

questions.stem: In thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, platelets are given:

options.text: For life-threatening bleeding, not for the number

questions.explanation: Platelets are for life-threatening bleeding, not for the number.

questions.stem: Fever and neutrophils under 500. The next step is:

options.text: Wait for the culture, then treat
Stop all antibiotics until the source is imaged

questions.explanation: Do not wait for the culture. Treat promptly.

questions.stem: A patient with sickle cell disease has a new infiltrate plus fever and hypoxia. This is:
questions.explanation: A new infiltrate plus chest pain, fever, or hypoxia is acute chest syndrome.

questions.stem: Incentive spirometry in sickle cell disease is used to:

options.text: Replace exchange transfusion in every case

questions.explanation: Incentive spirometry helps prevent acute chest. Severe disease can still need exchange.

questions.stem: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia is suspected five days after heparin. First steps:

options.text: Start warfarin alone and continue heparin
Stop all heparin and start a non-heparin anticoagulant
Watch and continue heparin if the wound looks fine

questions.explanation: Stop all heparin. Start a non-heparin anticoagulant. Do not start warfarin alone in the acute phase.

questions.stem: A smear suggests acute promyelocytic leukemia, and the patient is bleeding. All-trans retinoic acid:

options.text: Starts as soon as the diagnosis is suspected

questions.explanation: Start it when the smear already fits. Do not wait for the karyotype.

questions.stem: Fever, pain, and dark urine during a red-cell transfusion. The unit should be:

options.text: Stopped. Keep the bag and send it
Followed by a second unit immediately

questions.explanation: A suspected hemolytic reaction stops that unit. Do not slow it and watch.

questions.stem: Warfarin alone, in acute heparin-induced thrombocytopenia:

options.text: Should not be started as the only treatment in the acute phase

questions.explanation: Do not start warfarin alone in the acute phase.

questions.stem: Severe acute chest in sickle cell disease is:

options.text: More than pain medicine, and can need exchange transfusion
Treated by starting heparin and warfarin together
Ignored if incentive spirometry was used once

questions.explanation: Severe disease is more than pain medicine.
